p_intro: {company} ("we", "us") runs {name}. This policy explains what information the service handles and why.
p_intro_same: {company} ("we", "us") runs this website. This policy explains what information the service handles and why.
c_contact: What you type into our contact form: your name, email address and message.
c_mail: Your email address when you subscribe or take an action that needs a message from us. Newsletters carry an unsubscribe link.
c_files: Files you upload to the service.
p_use: To run and secure the service, to reply to you, to process what you ask for, and to understand in aggregate how the service is used so we can improve it. We do not sell your personal information.
ck_none: This site does not use cookies.
ck_essential: This site uses only the cookies it needs to work, such as the one that keeps you signed in. They do not track you.
p_share: We use these service providers, which process data on our behalf:
p_law: We may also share information when the law requires it.
p_rights: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete or export your information, to object to some uses, and to complain to your local data protection authority. To use these rights, contact us.
p_kids: The service is not directed at children under 13 (or the age required in your country), and we do not knowingly collect their information.
p_change: If we change this policy we will update the date above.
p_kids_yes: This service may be used by or for children, including children under 13 (for example when a parent books for their child). We collect a child's information only from a parent or guardian or with their consent, collect only what the service needs (such as the child's name and age), never use it for advertising and never sell it. A parent or guardian can see, correct or delete their child's information, or withdraw consent, at any time by contacting us.
x_bookings: Bookings and appointments: the details you give to book (date, time, service, contact details) are used to confirm, manage and remind you about your booking, and are kept for as long as needed to run the service and meet legal duties.
x_health: Health information: where you give us health-related details, we treat them as sensitive. We use them only to provide the service you asked for, limit who can see them, and never use them for advertising.
x_location: Location: if you share your location or address, we use it only to provide what you asked for, for example delivery or finding the nearest place.
x_content: Content you post: what you publish may be visible to others. You can ask us to remove your content, and you should not post other people's personal information.
